one_liner: Attach a script to any object so the companion or minimap can locate it by name.
primary_use_case: Makes objects scannable and discoverable via ping/pong events for companion or minimap navigation.
preview_recommendation: Show the updated companion video demonstrating terrain handling and ping response; useful for users to see UI configuration and ping/pong interaction.
manifest_quality_notes: Operates via local world events only
